title: pH modulates the role of SP6 RNA polymerase in transcription process: an in silico study.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接与MD模拟研究SP6 RNA聚合酶在不同pH下与启动子DNA的结合机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非典型TF体系。
abstract: SP6 RNA polymerase (SP6 RNAP) is an essential enzyme for the transcription process in SP6 bacteriophage. SP6 RNAP plays a vital role in mRNA vaccine designing technology and other translational biotechnology research due to the high specificity towards its promoter. The self-replicating performance also put this polymerase to study extensively. Despite of the reports emphasizing the function of this enzyme, a detailed structural and functional understanding of RNA polymerase is not reported so far. Here, we report the first-ever information about SP6RNAP structure and its effect on promoter binding at different pH environments using molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) study. We also report the changes in polymerase conformations in different pH conditions using in-silico approach. The docking study was also performed for SP6 RNAP with SP6 promoter at different pH environments using the in-silico docking tools and conducted the MDS study for complexes. MM/PBSA and per residue energy contribution has been performed at three different pH environments. The structural aspects confirmed that the pH 7.9 state favors the polymerase functional activity in the transcription process which was in the range reported using transcription assay. This polymerase's unique features may play its emerging role as an efficient transcription factor in translational biological research.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: SP6 RNA聚合酶（SP6 RNAP）是SP6噬菌体转录过程中的一种必需酶。由于其对其启动子的高度特异性，SP6 RNAP在mRNA疫苗设计技术及其他转化生物技术研究中发挥着重要作用。其自我复制性能也使该聚合酶被广泛研究。尽管已有报道强调该酶的功能，但迄今为止尚未有关于RNA聚合酶详细结构和功能理解的报道。在此，我们首次报道了SP6RNAP的结构信息及其在不同pH环境下对启动子结合的影响，采用分子对接和分子动力学模拟（MDS）研究。我们还通过计算机模拟方法报道了不同pH条件下聚合酶构象的变化。同时，利用计算机模拟对接工具在不同pH环境下对SP6 RNAP与SP6启动子进行了对接研究，并对复合物进行了MDS研究。在三种不同pH环境下进行了MM/PBSA和残基能量贡献分析。结构方面确认，pH 7.9状态有利于转录过程中聚合酶的功能活性，该范围与转录测定报告的结果一致。该聚合酶的独特特征可能使其在转化生物学研究中作为高效转录因子发挥新兴作用。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
